description: A Jupyter Notebook containing Python code for database connection, SQL query generation using OpenAI, and data retrieval and presentation related to a school database. It includes code for setting environment variables, initializing models, generating prompts, executing queries, and generating answers based on data.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt string combining user question and additional instructions for SQL query generation.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a chat completion request to OpenAI API with the full query and task description, returns the response.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed between ```sql and ``` from the model's output.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates the cost based on token usage for query and answer outputs.
